description: Create a VLC playlist that combines specific time segments from multiple instructional videos into a seamless practice sequence
instruction:
You are preparing training material by extracting specific segments from 4 tutorial videos. Create a playlist file at /home/ga/Videos/playlists/practice_sequence.xspf (or .m3u8) that plays these segments in order:

1. tutorial_01_basics.mp4 from 2:15 to 2:45 (body isolation)
2. tutorial_02_intermediate.mp4 from 4:30 to 5:00 (footwork)
3. tutorial_03_arms.mp4 from 1:00 to 1:40 (arm movements)
4. tutorial_04_cooldown.mp4 from 8:00 to 9:30 (stretching)

The playlist should play only these segments seamlessly. Configure it to loop/repeat if possible.

metadata.real_world_scenario: Dance instructor creating custom practice sequence for class
